name: TM10
description: The attack power varies among different Pokémon.

gifts.note: Guess the coin three times. This old woman in a house in Fortree City hides a coin in one hand three times. The answers are always Right, Right, then Left. Get all three right and she gives you the Hidden Power TM. A wrong guess just ends the game; talk to her again to retry.

Beat your Dad (Badge 5). The Petalburg Gym Leader battles you once you have the first four badges. After the battle you get TM Package 5 (a set of TMs that go straight into your TM Case) and an Assault Vest. If your Bag had no room for the Assault Vest, talk to him again.
